source.title: Essentiality and Control in Gene Regulatory Networks
source.author: Rudi Agius

essentiality.context: T-helper differentiation, overexpression (SA1), worst-effect reference set
essentiality.metric: Top Rank Cost; lower is better
essentiality.reference: Ranking derived from preservation/loss of synchronous Boolean attractors, not experimental viability

control.context: T-cell receptor signaling, ZAP70 target ON; target intervention explicitly allowed
control.metric: Final reward: preservation reward multiplied by control reward; higher is better
control.policy: ZAP70 ON, LAT OFF, x; x is an ineffective third mutation, not a named fixed gene
control.aggregation: Reported values; no uncertainty or repeated-run aggregation specified for this separate neutralization experiment
